**I'm submitting a ...**  (check one with "x")
```
[X] bug report => After upgrade from beta.8 to rc.1, Exit animation is not called
[ ] feature request
[ ] support request => Please do not submit support request here, instead see https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#question
```

**Current behavior**
I have animation defined in template as follows:
```
<div *ngFor="let toast of toasts" [@inOut]="animate" (@inOut.done)="onAnimationEnd($event)">
{{toast.name}}
<div>
```

animation decoration as:
```
 animations: [
    trigger('inOut', [
      state('flyRight', style({opacity: 1, transform: 'translateX(0)'})),
      transition('void => flyRight', [
        style({
          opacity: 0,
          transform: 'translateX(100%)'
        }),
        animate('0.2s ease-in')
      ]),
      transition('flyRight => void', [
        animate('0.2s 10 ease-out', style({
          opacity: 0,
          transform: 'translateX(100%)'
        }))
      ]), ....
```

The entering animation `void => flyRight` works as expected, but no animation for `flyRight => void` at all when a `toast` is removed from `toasts` array.

issue.body:
# 🐞 bug report

### Affected Package
@angular/animations and @angular/core


### Is this a regression?
Yes because this should've been fixed by #15193


### Description
If a component exists with only a host binding that talks to an animation then if that host element is removed from the parent component it will not trigger the animations to run.

## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction
<!--
Please create and share minimal reproduction of the issue starting with this template: https://stackblitz.com/fork/angular-issue-repro2
-->
<!-- ✍️-->
https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-ctywai?file=src%2Findex.html

## 🔥 Exception or Error
No animations are run


## 🌍  Your Environment

**Angular Version:**
Angular 7.0.0 on Chrome.
